record.question: Identify the Part of Speech of the word 'yourself' in: You have deceived yourself.
record.explanation: Answer B: Pronoun. “Yourself” is a reflexive pronoun referring back to the subject “you.” Independent check: “Yourself” refers back to “you” as the object of the verb; it is a reflexive pronoun, a subtype of pronoun. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/reflexive-pronouns. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
